<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$stage-code-review-findings</code></p>

Perform an approval-gated code review whose findings stay in chat until selected. Use for local, draft, or pre-publication review, or when only accepted findings may be translated and sent to a named destination.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link stage-code-review-findings --scope user
arcantry skills link stage-code-review-findings --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link stage-code-review-findings --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Examples

### Review without publishing

**Prompt**

> Use $stage-code-review-findings to review my uncommitted changes. Keep every finding in Polish and in chat only.

**Expected outcome**

Actionable findings with stable IDs, tight line anchors, and no source edits, browser drafts, or provider mutations.

### Publish selected findings only

**Prompt**

> Accept F1 and F3 from the staged review and prepare them for the named pull request. Leave every other finding unpublished.

**Expected outcome**

Only the accepted findings advance in concise reviewer-facing English after their anchors are revalidated.
